analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($0.25) vs SMA5($0.23)/SMA20($0.21)/SMA50($0.20): Confirmed above short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100($0.18)/SMA200($0.21): Strengthening mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (14.2%) + Recovering from near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (44.2→69.1): Exited oversold, entered overbought, continuing upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0028→0.0029): Improvement confirmed, strengthening bullish trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near upper band $0.24): Approaching upper band, potential for band expansion at 23.05% width.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.24): Confirmed support based on Pivot S1($0.21) and SMA20($0.21).
· Swing resistance ($0.26): Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.91x): Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Buy entry condition met on confirmation of $0.24 support.
